ground:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: seamless medieval strategy game GROUND TEXTURE ONLY, production source for maps.
Input image 1 (/home/project-server/Downloads/game theme.webp) is the sole art-style and ground-color reference, not a composition to copy.
Create a high-resolution landscape 4:3 texture plate consisting ONLY of the flat olive/moss/yellow-green meadow ground visible between the buildings in the reference. Hand-painted medieval atlas, subtle warm parchment grain and tiny fine dry-brush grass marks, muted earthy color and crisp fine texture. Almost uniformly lit, restrained low-contrast natural variation at small scale. Edge-to-edge ground at the exact same perspective across the whole image; no horizon, vignette, border, lighting gradient, scenery silhouette or central focal object.
ABSOLUTELY NO trees, shrubs, rocks, mountains, flowers, buildings, tents, farms, fields, fences, ruins, props, rivers, water, roads, tracks, paths, symbols, text, grids or shadows of objects. All those elements are separately rendered by the game. Do not make a landscape scene. This is a clean reusable opaque ground-material texture, matching the olive ground of the uploaded painting, NOT bright green lawn, not pale beige sand, not photographic grass, not blurry clouds. Consistent color at all four edges for tiling. Target fine detailed 2048px-or-greater landscape source if supported.

camps.gold:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent Gold Camp game sprite, edited from input image 1.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing yellow-and-slate gold counting pavilion, small tents, chest, coins, sacks and wooden cart.
Image 2 is a GROUND COLOR/TEXTURE reference for the game underneath the sprite.
Image 3 is the ART STYLE reference: hand-painted medieval atlas with fine dark ink outlines.
Preserve the existing Gold camp, all tent architecture, objects, placement, silhouette, south-facing entrance, camera angle, overall composition and scale within its square canvas. Do not redesign the scene or add people.
CHANGE ONLY THE FLOOR: remove the large pale beige dirt-and-grass island/platform and its visible perimeter. Make open ground between and around objects genuinely transparent so the game's olive meadow can show through. Keep only very small soft olive-brown contact shadows beneath tents/objects and a few understated muted olive grass strokes where necessary. No broad opaque ground, no outlined patch, no dark floating drop-shadow, no dirt halo, no rocks or bushes forming a perimeter. Existing camp props remain intact. Remove red/yellow edge fringing. Any tiny retained ground at tent feet must match the second image's olive color. Cutout should blend naturally on that texture rather than looking like a sticker or separate raised island.
Output true RGBA with transparent background, square canvas, crisp painted details and clean alpha edges. Keep the original object registration and framing, no text or UI.
